content: The Risk Calculator ADA (American Diabetes Association) Comprehensive Risk Factor Assessment involves the use of the American College of Cardiology ASCVD Risk Calculator, also known as the Risk Estimator Plus. This tool is specifically designed to estimate the 10-year risk of experiencing a first atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD) event. It serves as a critical resource for healthcare providers to identify individuals who are most likely to benefit from targeted interventions, such as statin therapy. Importantly, the calculator incorporates diabetes as a significant risk factor, recognizing that the presence of diabetes markedly elevates the likelihood of developing ASCVD.
